title: Ordinary exchange of the diagonal section unit
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, f:X -> S proper, P=ProjectiveLine(S), i:X isomorphic to P over S, and a either projection. Write D and DP for ordinary derived direct image of the diagonals on X and P; R and T for ordinary direct image of the a-projections; V and Q for pullback along i and its self-product map. Write delta and deltaP for their constant-object diagonal units, p for the constant-object projection unit on X, v for the constant pullback comparison along i, e for diagonal proper exchange, and b for projection proper exchange, all from [def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data]. Then p followed by R(delta), R(D(v inverse)), R(e inverse at A_P), and b inverse at DP(A_P) equals v inverse followed by V(projectiveLineDiagonalAlpha A S a). This assertion uses only ordinary direct images and pullbacks, with no compact supports or tensor-unit comparison.

source.place: The equation M = Rp2_* Delta_* M, the diagonal is a section for either projection, and substitution of canonical pullback counits before applying direct image.

proof.text: Apply inverse constant-object proper exchange to the diagonal square and projection square. Combine the two diagonal direct-image maps using functoriality, then replace the diagonal unit and inverse exchanges by the inverse self-product coefficient comparison followed by pulled-back diagonal unit. Use naturality of inverse projection exchange to move the pulled-back diagonal unit to the right. Apply inverse projection unit exchange. Finally rewrite projectiveLineDiagonalAlpha as the projection unit followed by the direct image of the diagonal unit, and join the two pullback maps using functoriality. This works for both projections and for the empty scheme.

theorem ordinarySection_exchange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f]
    (i : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (hi : i.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f)
    (a : Bool) :
    supportedDerivedUnit A (projection f a) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (projection f a)).map
          (supportedDerivedUnit A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (projection f a)).map
          ((ordinaryFinitePushforward A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)).map
            (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A i.hom).inv) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (projection f a)).map
          ((properExchange A (diagonalSquare f i hi)).inv.app
            (ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S))) ≫
        (properExchange A (projectionSquare f i hi a)).inv.app
          ((ordinaryFinitePushforward A (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S))).obj
            (ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S))) =
      (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A i.hom).inv ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).map (projectiveLineDiagonalAlpha A S a)
